category: MediaPipe Tasks / Pose Landmarker / Google AI Edge / Web ML
headline: Pose Landmarker のマスク出力を描画予算として触る
headlineEn: Treating Pose Landmarker masks as a rendering-budget decision
summary: Google AI Edge の Pose Landmarker Web guide、MediaPipe Tasks JS API reference、Tasks Vision README、GitHub 上の PoseLandmarkerOptions と segmentation graph、公式 mediapipe-samples-web を確認し、実モデル接続前に confidence gate、outputSegmentationMasks、マスク解像度、canvas overlay cost を調整する自作サンプルを追加しました。派生試作として、ランドマーク visibility と world-depth 風の値からアプリ用イベントを作る小さな router も実装しました。
summaryEn: After checking the Google AI Edge Pose Landmarker Web guide, MediaPipe Tasks JS API reference, Tasks Vision README, PoseLandmarkerOptions and segmentation graph on GitHub, and the official mediapipe-samples-web project, this adds an original sample for tuning confidence gates, outputSegmentationMasks, mask resolution, and canvas overlay cost before a real model is connected. A derivative prototype adds a small router that turns landmark visibility and world-depth-like values into app events.
keyTopics: Pose Landmarker Web guide は `runningMode`、`numPoses`、`minPoseDetectionConfidence`、`minPosePresenceConfidence`、`minTrackingConfidence`、`outputSegmentationMasks` を主要設定として示している。
Pose Landmarker の出力は normalized landmarks、world landmarks、任意の segmentation masks で、ランドマークは33点、world landmarks は腰中心を原点にしたメートル単位の3D座標として説明されている。
GitHub の `pose_landmarker_options.d.ts` でも `outputSegmentationMasks` は boolean かつ default false とされ、マスクは明示的に要求する出力として扱う必要がある。
MediaPipe graph 側の segmentation 処理は enable flag で gate され、landmarks、world landmarks、segmentation mask は別出力として扱われるため、UI でも採用条件と描画コストを分けて設計しやすい。
npm 確認では 2026-09-06 JST 時点で `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` は latest `1.0.1`、nightly `1.0.1-rc.20260905`、`@mediapipe/tasks-genai` は latest `0.10.29` だった。
keyTopicsEn: The Pose Landmarker Web guide lists `runningMode`, `numPoses`, `minPoseDetectionConfidence`, `minPosePresenceConfidence`, `minTrackingConfidence`, and `outputSegmentationMasks` as core options.

Pose Landmarker output includes normalized landmarks, world landmarks, and optional segmentation masks; the guide describes 33 landmarks and world landmarks as 3D coordinates in meters around the hip midpoint.
The GitHub `pose_landmarker_options.d.ts` confirms `outputSegmentationMasks` is a boolean with a default of false, so mask output should be treated as an explicit request.

The MediaPipe graph gates segmentation behind an enable flag and emits landmarks, world landmarks, and segmentation masks separately, which maps well to separate UI acceptance and rendering-cost decisions.
An npm check on 2026-09-06 JST showed `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` latest `1.0.1`, nightly `1.0.1-rc.20260905`, and `@mediapipe/tasks-genai` latest `0.10.29`.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は Pose Landmarker の optional segmentation mask です。公式 Web guide は normalized landmarks、world landmarks、segmentation masks を分けて説明し、`outputSegmentationMasks` は default false の明示オプションです。面白いのは、姿勢推定の結果をただ線で描くだけでなく、人物マスクを出すか、どの confidence を満たした時だけ採用するか、canvas overlay を何ピクセル相当まで許すかを UI の設計問題として扱える点です。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable point is the Pose Landmarker optional segmentation mask. The official Web guide separates normalized landmarks, world landmarks, and segmentation masks, while `outputSegmentationMasks` is an explicit option that defaults to false. The interesting part is treating pose output not only as skeleton drawing, but as a UI decision: when to request a person mask, which confidence gates must pass, and how much canvas overlay work is acceptable.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命サンプル `Pose Mask Budget Lab` は、合成した人物 skeleton と人物マスクを表示し、detection / presence / tracking の gate、mask resolution、mask alpha、`outputSegmentationMasks` の on/off を動かせます。timeline は accepted、mask drawn、dropped を分けて表示します。派生の `Pose Visibility Event Router` は、visibility gate、腕上げ角度、depth lean、confirm frames を使い、Pose のランドマーク結果を `right-arm-raise` や `lean-forward` のようなアプリイベントへ変換します。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `Pose Mask Budget Lab`, displays a synthetic person skeleton and person mask while exposing detection, presence, tracking gates, mask resolution, mask alpha, and the `outputSegmentationMasks` toggle. Its timeline separates accepted frames, mask-drawn frames, and dropped frames. The derivative `Pose Visibility Event Router` uses a visibility gate, arm-raise angle, depth lean, and confirmation frames to convert pose landmarks into app events such as `right-arm-raise` or `lean-forward`.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.titleEn: Possibilities unlocked by sample data and combinations
sections.body: 蓄積できるデータは、confidence gate、accepted/dropped frame、mask pixel estimate、overlay cost estimate、mask alpha、33点ランドマーク風の座標、visibility、world-depth 風の値、stable event、confirm streak です。これを実 Pose Landmarker の `PoseLandmarkerResult`、Image Segmenter のマスク合成、Gesture Recognizer の手の合図、Web Audio のフィードバック音、WebXR の身体方向 UI、IndexedDB の練習ログ、Worker の latency telemetry と組み合わせると、運動フォーム確認、立ち位置ガイド、カメラ前プレゼン操作、マスク付き身体エフェクト、省負荷な姿勢イベント検出へ発展できます。
sections.bodyEn: The samples can accumulate confidence gates, accepted/dropped frames, mask pixel estimates, overlay cost estimates, mask alpha, synthetic 33-point-like landmark positions, visibility, world-depth-like values, stable events, and confirmation streaks. Combined with real `PoseLandmarkerResult`, Image Segmenter mask composition, Gesture Recognizer hand signs, Web Audio feedback, WebXR body-direction UI, IndexedDB practice logs, and worker latency telemetry, these can grow into exercise-form review, standing-position guidance, camera-based presentation controls, masked body effects, or low-cost pose-event detection.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 本命 HTML は `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.0.1/+esm` の dynamic import preflight を持ち、実装時の CDN / module 読み込み確認に使えます。本番化では `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()`、`PoseLandmarker.createFromOptions()`、`pose_landmarker_lite/full/heavy.task`、`runningMode: "VIDEO"`、`outputSegmentationMasks` を接続し、video loop では `detectForVideo(video, timestamp)` の結果と描画を分離します。マスクは出せば便利ですが、ImageData / canvas / texture 変換のコストが出るため、低解像度の preview と高解像度の capture を分ける設計が現実的です。
sections.bodyEn: The main HTML includes a dynamic import preflight for `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.0.1/+esm`, which helps verify CDN/module loading before real integration. For production, connect `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks()`, `PoseLandmarker.createFromOptions()`, `pose_landmarker_lite/full/heavy.task`, `runningMode: "VIDEO"`, and `outputSegmentationMasks`; in a video loop, separate `detectForVideo(video, timestamp)` results from drawing. Masks are useful, but ImageData/canvas/texture conversion has cost, so separating low-resolution preview from high-resolution capture is practical.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 明日以降は、Pose Landmarker Web guide の更新、Tasks Vision npm nightly、`mediapipe-samples-web` の worker 実装、pose model の lite/full/heavy URL、segmentation mask の JS 側 lifecycle、WebGPU / WebGL delegate の挙動、LiteRT 側の Web 展開を継続して見ます。特に mask を複数人や高解像度 canvas で扱う時のメモリ解放と描画経路は要注意です。
sections.bodyEn: Next, watch the Pose Landmarker Web guide, Tasks Vision npm nightlies, worker implementation in `mediapipe-samples-web`, lite/full/heavy pose model URLs, JavaScript-side segmentation mask lifecycle, WebGPU/WebGL delegate behavior, and LiteRT's Web path. Memory release and draw paths are especially important when masks are used with multiple people or high-resolution canvases.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `Pose Mask Budget Lab` を開き、`outputSegmentationMasks` を on/off しながら `Mask resolution` を上げます。mask pixels と estimated canvas cost が増え、confidence gate が足りない時は dropped として timeline に残ります。派生サンプルでは `Visibility gate` と `Confirm frames` を上げ、腕上げイベントが stable event になるまでの遅延を見ます。
sections.bodyEn: Open `Pose Mask Budget Lab`, toggle `outputSegmentationMasks`, and raise `Mask resolution`. The mask-pixel and estimated-canvas-cost values increase, while frames that miss the confidence gates are left as dropped ticks in the timeline. In the derivative sample, raise `Visibility gate` and `Confirm frames` to see how long an arm-raise candidate takes to become a stable event.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Pose Landmarker Web guide、JS API reference、Tasks Vision README、PoseLandmarkerOptions の型定義、pose segmentation graph、公式 Web demo/source、npm package version を確認。設計: 外部デモ一覧ではなく、マスク出力と姿勢イベント化の運用判断を自作 UI 化。実装: 本命 HTML に synthetic skeleton、optional mask、confidence gates、mask pixel/cost estimate、accepted/drop timeline、Tasks import check を追加。派生 HTML に landmark visibility、arm angle、world-depth 風 lean、confirm frames、stable event log を追加。検証: JSON parse、gallery build、publish command、GitHub Pages の top/day/sample HTTP 200 を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked the Pose Landmarker Web guide, JS API reference, Tasks Vision README, PoseLandmarkerOptions type definition, pose segmentation graph, official web demo/source, and npm package versions. Design: instead of listing external demos, turn mask output and pose-event operation decisions into original UI. Implementation: added a synthetic skeleton, optional mask, confidence gates, mask-pixel/cost estimates, accepted/drop timeline, and Tasks import check to the main HTML. Added landmark visibility, arm angle, world-depth-like lean, confirmation frames, and a stable event log to the derivative HTML. Validation: check JSON parse, gallery build, publish command, and HTTP 200 responses for the top, day, and representative sample pages.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 直近は mask lifecycle、similarity routing、worker frame gate、Image Classifier の ROI と policy を扱ってきました。今日の2本は Pose Landmarker を、描画負荷とアプリイベント化の観点で整理します。MediaPipe Tasks の Web サンプルは、モデル呼び出しだけでなく、どの出力を有効化するか、どの frame を UI へ通すか、どの連続条件で状態を変えるかまで小さく試すと、後で実カメラに接続しやすくなります。
sections.bodyEn: Recent entries covered mask lifecycle, similarity routing, worker frame gates, and Image Classifier ROI/policy. Today's two samples organize Pose Landmarker around rendering cost and app-event conversion. MediaPipe Tasks web samples become easier to connect to a real camera when they test not only model calls, but also which outputs are enabled, which frames reach the UI, and which consecutive conditions change app state.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した本命は `Pose Mask Budget Lab` です。実際に動く部分は、合成 skeleton、任意の人物マスク、detection / presence / tracking gate、mask resolution、mask alpha、mask pixel estimate、estimated canvas cost、accepted/drop timeline、Tasks Vision import preflight です。次に足すなら実 `PoseLandmarker.detectForVideo()`、`outputSegmentationMasks` の実 mask 描画、lite/full/heavy モデル切替、worker 分離、mask ImageData の明示 release 監視を追加します。派生試作は `Pose Visibility Event Router` で、実際に動く部分は visibility gate、腕上げ角度、world-depth 風 lean、confirm frames、stable event log です。次に足すなら実 `PoseLandmarkerResult.landmarks` / `worldLandmarks` を読み込み、運動フォームの rep counter と Web Audio feedback をつなぎます。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `Pose Mask Budget Lab`. The working pieces are a synthetic skeleton, optional person mask, detection/presence/tracking gates, mask resolution, mask alpha, mask-pixel estimate, estimated canvas cost, accepted/drop timeline, and Tasks Vision import preflight. Next additions should connect real `PoseLandmarker.detectForVideo()`, draw real masks from `outputSegmentationMasks`, switch lite/full/heavy models, split work into a worker, and monitor explicit mask ImageData release. The derivative prototype is `Pose Visibility Event Router`; the working pieces are visibility gate, arm-raise angle, world-depth-like lean, confirmation frames, and a stable event log. Next, feed in real `PoseLandmarkerResult.landmarks` / `worldLandmarks`, then add an exercise rep counter and Web Audio feedback.
